Three ink icons on one ground line, 1200x300: train (#rail), road van (#road), plane (#air).
Brown glass acid bottle (160x280 inside a 400x400 prop) with a glass stopper and a white label carrying a corrosive hazard icon (drops falling on a hand and a bar inside a diamond); ink outline.
A bunch of four bananas lying on their side (about 306x152 inside a 400x400 prop), yellow with ink outline, stem at left.
Cylindrical battery (120x240 inside a 400x400 prop) in ink with a sand body, an ink top band with a small plus mark, and a small grey terminal cap.

Stack of five coins (190x178 inside a 400x400 prop), mixed yellow-gold and grey, milled edges, ink outline; no denomination.

Sand post-office counter top seen front-on, 1760x260: deep flat top surface (back edge at y 20, front edge at y 232) and a thin front face (y 232-256) with one darker line; 3 px ink outline, no lettering. Placed at translate(80 720) its back edge is y 740 of the frame.
Bundle of banknotes (320x160 inside a 400x400 prop) held by a sand paper band, pale green-grey notes with a plain border and a blank oval; no denomination or real design.
Small wooden crate (300x220 inside a 400x400 prop) with plank lines and a slate warning diamond carrying an ink burst icon on the front; 3 px ink outline.
Trapezoid bullion bar / ingot (300x140 inside a 400x400 prop), India Post yellow with a lighter top face and a blank recessed panel, ink outline; no marks.
Round metal tin of hing (228x248 inside a 400x400 prop), grey, with a rolled lid seam and a soldered-looking seal line under the lid, and a blank white label band.
Open small jewellery box (260x204 inside a 400x400 prop), sand outside, red velvet inside, a yellow-gold necklace laid on the velvet of the raised lid; ink outline.
Lottery ticket (380x180 inside a 400x400 prop), cream with a perforated stub at left, a blank title strip and six blank number boxes; no lettering.

Ordinary medicine bottle (160x240 inside a 400x400 prop), pale glass with a white ridged cap and a white label with a plain ink cross mark; ink outline.

A knife / cutting blade (about 386x52 inside a 400x400 prop) with an ink handle and a grey blade; a separate sheath part (#sheath, sand, thick outline, hidden at opacity 0) to show over the blade to make it covered.

Open sorting tray 440x200, slate #4b4f58 rim and front (pale slate face), a slate cross drawn on the front at left; blank front space (x 120-420, y 115-185) for a Hindi label; inside floor visible. Front lip at y 100 (where an article dropped in rests).

Open sorting tray 440x200, ink rim, cream front with a round grey postmark ring at left; blank front space (x 120-420, y 115-185) for a Hindi label. Front lip at y 100.

Cut-away packing diagram 700x520: outer wooden box with metal corners (#outer), absorbent sawdust/bran fill drawn as small dots (#fill), inner glass bottle with cap (#inner); each part separate for a layer-by-layer build. No lettering.
Small paint / varnish tin (208x232 inside a 400x400 prop), grey with a lid, an amber varnish drip down the side and a blank white label band; ink outline.
Small round sand tin with a grey ridged screw lid and thread band, and a blank white label panel on its side (x 106-254, y 150-230, gently curved) for the scene's words.

Book Post packet: three stacked books (red covers, white page edges) in a sand paper wrapper tied with an ink string cross and bow, the right end left open so the three page-edge ends show, with two small paper flaps folding out; 3 px ink, rounded ends. The wrapper face between the string lines is clear for a scene's handwritten label.

Flat ink postal counter scale: cream platform on a short post above a postal-red base with two dark feet and a round white dial with a blank face. The needle points straight up at rest; turn it with rotate(angle 260 314) (the pivot anchor) to show a reading. Put a packet on the platform at the top anchor.

A rolled paper document lying horizontally: white body with faint #ead9a8 edge lines, rounded left end, and its round end on the right drawn as an ellipse with a spiral and a centre dot (end-centre anchor) for a diameter arrow. The roll end spans x 574-626, y 30-130.

Unsealed white envelope seen from the back with its seam lines, 3 px ink. Three flap states, one shown at a time: #flap-open (sand flap standing up, visible by default), #flap-tucked (flap folded inside, shown as a dashed outline; starts at opacity 0) and #flap-pasted (flap down with a glue sheen line; starts at opacity 0). To switch, set the wanted state's opacity to 1 and #flap-open's to 0.

Open corrugated cardboard box in sand with its flaps folded out, ink flute waves on the front cut edge, and a drawn glass tumbler standing inside (its top above the box). The front face is clear for a scene's label.

Cross-section of a strong sand outer box (hatched walls) with a hermetically sealed cream jar inside (dark ink screw lid band, pale liquid up to a level line), the gap filled with dotted sawdust and a few cotton tufts, and a tight lid on top. #liquid is one group whose bottom sits on the jar's inner base (y 437).

A bundle of printed papers with no wrapper, seen slightly from above: white top sheet with grey print lines (no words), sand stacked sheet edges, tied with an ink string cross and a small bow; 3 px ink.

A closed red book in a sand sleeve (slip case) slid half off to the right; the sleeve's open edge has a thumb notch showing the book, and the book carries a blank cream label plate. Slide #book right or back into #sleeve with translate.
Flat ink plane icon, white body with a blue #2456a6 stripe; 360x200.
